fonts.display: 'Gestura (custom serif)', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Bone White
palette.role: Primary canvas, card surfaces, button text, input fills

palette.name: Graphite Ink
palette.role: Primary borders, hairline dividers, link underlines, heading accents

palette.name: Deep Coal
palette.role: High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Body and heading text at maximum weight, dark hero overlays, icon strokes

palette.name: Press Black
palette.role: Hardest text and button fills where pure black is needed for contrast over warm photography

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Secondary body text, helper copy, muted icon strokes

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Disabled button borders, low-emphasis outlines, decorative hairlines

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Badge fills, input borders, tag backgrounds — the lightest non-canvas neutral

palette.name: Cloud
palette.role: Elevated card backgrounds, subtle surface lift above the canvas

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Mid-weight button borders, heavy outlines on dark surfaces
